description: Image Description: The image shows a kitchen scene on a countertop. There is a stick of unsalted butter in its original packaging, which is labeled with "Land O'Lakes" and various details including "USDA" and "Grade AA". To the right of the butter is a pair of kitchen scissors, partially open. An orange or yellow oven mitt is visible in the bottom right corner. In the top left corner, there is a part of a metal object, possibly a pot or pan.
